scope: Original whole living antiarch with box-like anterior armor and paired articulated pectoral paddles; not Bothriolepis reused geometry or walking/flying creature.

taxon.context: Middle Devonian Old Red Sandstone, Scotland; no exact lake/feeding reconstruction.
anchors: Trewin Fig2 dorsal/ventral/lateral reconstruction explicitly after Hemmings1978
eLife2022 article76661 Fig8 P.milleri scale-region comparison

scale.basis: All artist nominal targets, NOT exact specimen dimensions or universal species size. Refine proportions from figures and report actual bounds.

pose: Neutral horizontal aquatic/resting-near-bottom attitude without terrain. Pectoral paddles partly swept backward/outward and separated from body; not fully extended flight wings or load-bearing legs. Tail gently straight.

surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.materials: 4–6 subdued gray/olive/slate/tan palette values, not fossil pigment claim. No emissive eyes.
surface_profile.detail: Closed thin-solid fins, single-sided materials; no paper-thin DoubleSide planes. Selective facet/scale structure, no thousands of separate scales or detached bead objects.

coordinates.origin: Model centerline projected to lowest-body reference plane at Z0; neutral unsupported swimming pose, no stand. State exact bounds.

view_plan.source: Exact final GLB clean-import, fixed numeric camera/light/color template and hash-bound manifest.
view_plan.greybox: Inspect silhouette/body thickness and all fin placements before detail.
view_plan.extra_views: Only targeted diagnostic for concrete ambiguity; no mandatory8 views in current scoped making.

scientific_limits: TrewinFig3 is direct published fossil photograph but specimen catalog ID not supplied; detached head and spread appendages are taphonomic pose, not live anatomy.

TrewinFig2 is an expert secondary reconstruction after primary Hemmings1978, not newly measured fossil. eLifeFig8 is a comparative redraw, not actual pigment or identical individual. These evidence types remain distinct.
Paddle distal-width variants documented but not proven sex; choose moderate form, do not label male/female or count variant as new asset.
Bony plate form/appendages supported; exact living skin, thickness, eye tissues, colors and fin-web edges artistic. No speculative pelvic fins, anal fin, walking joints or claws.
Head must attach to anterior shield; do not preserve detached fossil head. Small dorsal eye region must not become empty helmet hole.
Mouth ventral and understated, nearly closed; no displayed teeth. Feeding/rowing/weak-swimmer statements are interpretations, not behaviors represented by this static model.
Scale-region chart colors are categorical labels, never life coloration. Only P.milleri panel used, not adjacent Bothriolepis/Asterolepis/Remigolepis.

morphology.obligation: Distinct anterior armor box with broadly flat underside and arched/faceted dorsal roof; small attached front headshield with dorsal eye region. A few structural plate seams, not random stone blocks or turtle shell scutes.

Exactly two long narrow bony pectoral paddles articulated laterally to anterior armor, with readable proximal/distal segments and tapered distal ends. Preserve continuous joint roots and clearance; no feather membranes, fingers, elbows or duplicated paddles.

Posterior body exits rear shield as a longer narrowing scaled tail region; one small dorsal fin on posterior body and strongly heterocercal caudal with axial extension into UPPER lobe. Lower fin web smaller; not Birkenia lower-long orientation or symmetric tuna fork.
morphology.source: TrewinFig2 side/description and eLifeFig8 P.milleri panel.

morphology.obligation: Armor plates visibly larger than tail scales. Tail has restrained orderly scale/facet rows; finite thin-solid dorsal/caudal webs. No full-body sphere tiles or chart-colored stripes.

acceptance_obligations: Four exactGLB front/side/top/perspective: top must show two bony paddle forms, head attached and shield plate organization; side flat belly/arched back, long scaled tail and upper-long heterocercal caudal; front shield thickness and dorsal eyes; perspective clean paddle roots/segments and fin webs.
External appendages:two armored pectoral paddles+one small dorsal+one caudal. No extra modern paired pelvic fans, legs, teeth or detached head.
Source-specific paddle/armor proportions must distinguish from generic antiarch; no reused Bothriolepis mesh or same model recolor.
Closed single-sided solids and thin finite fin webs; two complete deterministic builds with semantic digests; default helpers; exactGLB/native/export/validator reports and independent morphology QA.
Full production8/GPU/scene/user acceptance remains separate unclaimed; any underside mouth/armor ambiguity may use one targeted diagnostic.
production_boundary: Full static-stylized-v1 production8/GPU/scene contract is retained as reference but NOT claimed passed or imposed as current maker scope; user-requested4view model acceptance is separate.

revision_scope.requested_change: Only continuous armor-region layout: source-led central dorsal and paired shoulder/lateral plates, no three circumferential rings or overlays.
